script.source: GOB 481 invokes BufferOverflowInit, BufferOverflowUpdate and BufferOverflowTerm; tempmods.py reserves min(value, free buffer).

stats.source: GOB 1091 sets the while-enabled 117 and 564 to +10 and +7 and runs NegativeConditionSweepPulse at 5% every 5 seconds.
